article.title: Pre‑Restructuring Checklist for IT Teams
article.body_markdown:
# Pre‑Restructuring Checklist for IT Teams

Before changing team structure, verify that security responsibilities, risk assessments, and control implementations align with recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF and CIS Controls. This reduces gaps that can arise from role shifts.
